_readme: Hand-written arrival templates (PROTOTYPE_SCOPE: text is hand-written templates only). Placeholders in {braces}. Beat order: recognition, wrongness, personal echo, discovery (SYSTEMS §11). Selection rules: PROPOSED P0-13.

recognition.fountain.runs: You climb out of the machine in AD {year}. The Tiber smells the same. In the Subura, the district fountain you repaired still runs: the basin is worn smooth, and someone has cut two words into its rim: AQUA PURA.
recognition.fountain.dry: You climb out of the machine in AD {year}. The Tiber smells the same. You find the district fountain you repaired by the shape of the street, but the basin is cracked and dry, full of leaves.
recognition.workshop.thrives: You climb out of the machine in AD {year}. The Tiber smells the same. Near the Porta Trigemina you hear hammers: the smith's workshop you funded has become a whole street of forges, and over the oldest door hangs a painted sign with two fires.
recognition.workshop.gone: You climb out of the machine in AD {year}. The Tiber smells the same. Near the Porta Trigemina you find the smith's workshop you funded by its soot-black wall. It is a stable now.
recognition.neither: You climb out of the machine in AD {year}. The Tiber smells the same. You pass the corner where the smith worked and the fountain ran foul. Neither is there. You remember letting both chances pass.
recognition.unchosenFountain.fixed: Down the street, the fountain you didn't choose was repaired after all. Someone else did it.
recognition.unchosenFountain.foul: Down the street, the fountain you didn't choose was filled in long ago. An old woman calls the spot 'fever corner'.
recognition.unchosenWorkshop.later: The smith's forge, which you funded later, still smokes a few doors down.
recognition.unchosenWorkshop.gone: Of the smith you didn't choose, there is no trace.
recognition.unchosenFountain.laterRuns: Down the street, the fountain you repaired later still runs.
recognition.unchosenFountain.laterDry: Down the street, the fountain you repaired later has gone dry again; no one kept it up after you left.

wrongness.medicine.high: Something is wrong, and it takes you a moment to see it: children, everywhere. More than any Roman street you remember, and fewer small graves along the Via Appia.
wrongness.medicine.low: Something is wrong. Whole blocks of the Subura have fallen in, the streets are half-empty, and people cover their mouths when strangers pass.
wrongness.governance.high: Something is wrong. Magistrates post their rulings in the forum and people stop to read them. Nobody seems afraid of the soldiers.
wrongness.governance.low: Something is wrong. There are soldiers at every corner and they are not all the same army. People talk about emperors the way they talk about the weather.
wrongness.economy.high: Something is wrong. The cattle market has spilled over its walls; you hear six languages haggling, and the coins are good silver.
wrongness.economy.low: Something is wrong. The markets are thin, bread costs a day's wage, and the silver coins are copper washed in silver.
wrongness.asHistory: Something is wrong, and it takes you a while to name it: beyond the few things you recognize, this is Rome almost exactly as the history books describe AD {year}.

personal.kept: In {keeper} you find a line carved over a door, in Demetria's Greek: 'For the one who stayed.' They don't know it means you.
personal.broken: In the oldest book of {keeper} there is a note in Demetria's hand: 'The foreigner promised to stay until the sickness passed. The sickness came in {outbreakYear}. The foreigner did not.'
personal.brokenNoKeeper: In a tomb inscription on the Via Latina you find Demetria's name, and a line she chose herself: 'I kept my promises.' You did not keep yours.
personal.refused: Demetria's letters survive in a library copy. One mentions you: 'The foreigner would not promise to stay. At least it was honest.'
personal.notOffered: You left before the first rumors came from the East. In the city's records, the pestilence of {outbreakYear} fills page after page: about {deaths} thousand dead in Rome. You aren't in any of them.
personal.notOfferedNoOutbreak: You left before the first rumors came from the East. You never learned whether Demetria would have asked you to stay.
personal.unanswered: Demetria's letters survive in a library copy. One mentions you: 'I asked the foreigner to stay until the sickness passed. I never had an answer.'
personal.neverAsked: Demetria's letters survive in a library copy. They name everyone who stayed to help the sick in {outbreakYear}. You are not among them; she never thought to ask you.

discovery.circle.thriving: The Physicians' Circle of the Subura still meets by the fountain. They teach, argue about remedies, and keep a copy of your charter under glass. Its head is {leader}.
discovery.circle.drifted: The circle you backed with Demetria is now {pathName}. {pathDescription} Its head, {leader}, speaks of the founders as a legend.
discovery.circle.dissolved: The Physicians' Circle is gone. One inscription remains, built into the wall of a newer house.
discovery.circle.rogue: The circle you backed is now {pathName}. {pathDescription} They know who you are, and they do not want you back.
discovery.faction.thriving: The Caecilian faction still sits together in the Curia, still arguing for honest courts. Its leader is {leader}.
discovery.faction.drifted: The senate faction you backed with Varro is now {pathName}. {pathDescription}
discovery.faction.captured: The senate faction you backed with Varro is now {pathName}. {pathDescription} Its head is {leader}.
discovery.faction.dissolved: Of the Caecilian faction nothing remains but a family tomb.
discovery.faction.rogue: The senate faction you backed is now {pathName}. {pathDescription} They know who you are, and they do not want you back.
discovery.none: You ask at the guild halls and the Curia whether anyone remembers you. No one does: you never held enough of anything in Rome to leave your mark on it.
discovery.circle.corrupted: The Physicians' Circle still has a door and a name, but it licenses whoever pays. Its head, {leader}, answers to other people now.
discovery.faction.corrupted: The Caecilian faction still votes as a bloc, but its votes are for sale. Its head is {leader}.
discovery.corruption.minor: Its accounts show a gap from the years after you left: some of the gold you left was quietly skimmed (minor corruption).
discovery.corruption.major: Its records tell of a great embezzlement a generation after you left: half the treasury vanished and the payments you arranged stopped (major corruption).
discovery.corruption.total: Everyone knows the story: within a generation of your leaving, its whole treasury was stolen, and those who took it took the institution too (total corruption).
discovery.guild.thriving: The Merchants' Guild of Ostia still meets at the harbor, still arguing for open markets and honest coin. Its head is {leader}.
discovery.guild.drifted: The guild you backed at Ostia is now {pathName}. {pathDescription} Its head is {leader}.
discovery.guild.captured: The guild you backed at Ostia is now {pathName}. {pathDescription} Its head is {leader}.
discovery.guild.dissolved: Of the Merchants' Guild of Ostia nothing remains but a name carved on a warehouse lintel.
discovery.guild.rogue: The guild you backed is now {pathName}. {pathDescription} They know who you are, and they do not want you back.
discovery.guild.corrupted: The Merchants' Guild still has its hall at Ostia, but its treasury was emptied long ago and its seats are for sale. Its head is {leader}.
discovery.generic.thriving: {name}, which {how}, is still there and still itself. Its head is {leader}.
discovery.generic.drifted: {name}, which {how}, is now {pathName}. {pathDescription} Its head is {leader}.
discovery.generic.captured: {name}, which {how}, is now {pathName}. {pathDescription} Its head is {leader}.
discovery.generic.corrupted: {name}, which {how}, still has its name and its door, but its treasury was emptied long ago and its seats are for sale. Its head is {leader}.
discovery.generic.dissolved: Of {name}, which {how}, nothing remains but a name no one recognizes.
discovery.generic.rogue: {name}, which {how}, is now {pathName}. {pathDescription} They know who you are, and they do not want you back.
